summary: The bill makes it a federal crime to knowingly publish nonconsensual intimate images or AI-generated deepfakes of adults or minors on interactive online services, and requires major websites and apps to remove such content within 48 hours after receiving a valid request from the person depicted.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses online content and requires platforms to remove certain depictions, which constitutes increased regulation on tech companies regarding user-generated content and privacy. It aims to protect individual privacy by mandating the removal of nonconsensual intimate visual depictions.
